scope: Seed evidence and source locators for the input specification. Not a complete functional knowledge base.

claims.locator: Figure 1 caption; sections 3.1 and 3.2; Table 2 abbreviation note
claims.paraphrase: The review identifies major and secondary protein families and explains their abbreviations. These are compositional categories, not interchangeable physiological-effect labels.
claims.limits: Naming does not validate every workbook column assignment or connect percentages directly to anatomy.

claims.paraphrase: The article distinguishes alpha-neurotoxins from cytotoxins within the three-finger family.
claims.limits: This is the article's background synthesis, not a new isolated-toxin experiment. A total 3FTx percentage does not specify its functional subtype composition.

claims.locator: Figure 2 and Results section sec3-5; Methods sec2-5-1
claims.paraphrase: The study presents PLA2 enzymatic activity alongside relative abundance and catalytic-status information.
claims.limits: Whole-venom in vitro enzyme assays do not establish prey-specific onset times, anatomy or the effect of every isolated PLA2 molecule.

claims.locator: Figure 3 and Results section sec3-6; Methods sec2-5-2
claims.paraphrase: The study reports substrate-based SVSP enzymatic activity and relative abundance for the sampled venoms.
claims.limits: A substrate assay is not a general prediction of net clotting behavior or snake appearance.

claims.locator: Figure 4 and Results section sec3-7; Methods sec2-5-2
claims.paraphrase: The study compares measured SVMP enzymatic activity with reported abundance and molecular classes.
claims.limits: Activities are assay-specific; they do not establish a quantitative relationship to body shape or prey behavior.

claims.locator: Figure 1 caption and Results section sec3-3
claims.paraphrase: This study groups SVMP-associated disintegrins with SVMPs while keeping other disintegrins separate.
claims.limits: That convention must not be assumed to match all studies in the compiled workbook.

claims.locator: Introduction, XML section sec1; Results section sec3-2
claims.paraphrase: The article discusses mamba dendrotoxins as members of the Kunitz-type group with potassium-channel effects.
claims.limits: Do not assign that identity or effect to every Kunitz-type protein or infer mamba anatomy from a family total.

claims.locator: RAW_DATABASE_VENOM header row 1: AC, AD, AY, H, I, AN, AP
claims.paraphrase: The workbook supplies separate CTL, CLP (Snaclec), CLP, NP, C-NP, BPP and BNP columns.
claims.limits: A distinct column does not prove a globally disjoint biological family; preserve source definitions until reviewed.

note: No direct toxin-percentage-to-physical-trait claim has been curated. Additional functional evidence is pending for several advanced controls.
